decisions.reason: Minimum quantity lubrication sits close to the firm's coolant and fluid-handling know-how for machine-tool users, so in-house R&D lets it interpret feedback and refine the system rather than abandon it.
The hydrocyclone coolant filter builds directly on the firm's established filtration platforms, so strong absorptive capacity supports continued improvement and integration into modular systems.
Gravity band filters are a core, well-understood filtration technology for the firm's machine-tool customers, fitting its modular offer with low risk and clear learning from customer use.
